sources.observation: A miners’ relief crowns the square entrance portal. The paved approach continues through a short open-sided landing into the dark mine opening.

sources.credit: Jonny Green / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
sources.observation: A tall blue cross stands over the altar against amber rock. Benches line the center aisle, and the side walls have saturated blue uplighting.

limitations: The lower route, cavern dimensions and depth are schematic. The three naves and entrance are modeled; the full tour and excavated network fall outside this model scope. A fixed below-ground review camera shows the nave.
